148std::vector<int> toBin(int number, UINT nBits = 0)
149{
150 // Takes an integer and returns a std::vector containing
151 // its binary representation
152
153 UINT i; // iterate over each bit
154 int bit; // temp storage of each bit
155 std::vector<int> bits; // return vector
156 while (number > 0)
157 {
158 bit = number & 1;
159 number = number >> 1;
160 bits.push_back(bit);
161 }
162 if (nBits > bits.size())
163 {
164 for (i = bits.size(); i < nBits; i++)
165 {
166 bits.push_back(0);
167 }
168 }
169 return bits;
170}

181int toInt(std::vector<int> v)
182{
183 // Takes a std::vector containing the binary representation
184 // of an integer and returns that integer
185
186 int counter = 0; // increasing iterator
187 int result = 0;
188 for (UINT i = 0; i < v.size(); i++)
189 {
190 result = result + v[i] * twoPow(counter);
191 counter++;
192 }
193 return result;
194}

371class tangent {
372 float slope;
373 UINT quadrant;
374 bool err;
375
376public:
377 tangent(float dx, float dy) {
378 init(dx, dy);
379 }
380 void init(float dx, float dy){
381 slope = 0;
382 err = false;
383 if (dx == 0 && dy == 0){
384 //tolog("Incorrect tangent!\n");
385 err = true;
386 }
387 if (dx < 0 && dy <= 0) {
388 quadrant = 1;
389 slope = dy / dx;
390 } else if (dx >= 0 && dy < 0) {
391 quadrant = 2;
392 slope = -dx / dy;
393 } else if (dx > 0 && dy >= 0) {
394 quadrant = 3;
395 slope = dy / dx;
396 } else {
397 quadrant = 4;
398 slope = -dx / dy;
399 }
400 }
401 void init(point p1, point p2){
402 float dx = p2.x - p1.x;
403 float dy = p2.y - p1.y;
404 slope = 0;
405 err = false;
406 init(dx, dy);
407 if (slope != slope){
408 tolog(_L_ + "Incorrect tangent: \n" + p1.croack() + p2.croack());
409 err = true;
410 }
411 }
412 tangent(){}
413 tangent(point p1, point p2){
414 init(p1, p2);
415 }
416 bool error(){
417 return err;
418 }
419 UINT getQuadrant(){
420 return quadrant;
421 }
422 float getSlope(){
423 return slope;
424 }
425 point transformPoint(point p, float r){
426 point result;
427 float sq = slope * slope;
428 float dy = r * sqrt(1/(1+sq));
429 float dx = slope * dy;
430 if (quadrant == 1){
431 result.x = p.x - dy;
432 result.y = p.y - dx;
433 }
434 else if (quadrant == 2){
435 result.x = p.x + dx;
436 result.y = p.y - dy;
437 }
438 else if (quadrant == 3){
439 result.x = p.x + dy;
440 result.y = p.y + dx;
441 }
442 else if (quadrant == 4){
443 result.x = p.x - dx;
444 result.y = p.y + dy;
445 }
446 return result;
447 }
448 //void operator=(tangent t) {
449 // quadrant = t.quadrant;
450 // slope = t.slope;
451 //}
452 void rotate(tangent t) {
453 if (t.quadrant == quadrant && t.slope == slope){
454 slope = 0;
455 quadrant = 1;
456 return;
457 }
458 float tslope = t.slope;
459 float s = slope;
460 if (t.slope > 0) {
461 tslope = 1 / t.slope;
462 } else {
463 quadrant++;
464 }
465 quadrant += 4 - t.quadrant;
466 if ((s * tslope) == 1) {
467 slope = 0;
468 quadrant++;
469 } else {
470 slope = (s + tslope) / (1 - s * tslope);
471 if (slope < 0) {
472 quadrant++;
473 slope = -1 / slope;
474 }
475 }
476 quadrant = (quadrant - 1) % 4 + 1;
477 }
478
479 tangent bisect(tangent t){
480 tangent t1 = *this;
481 tangent t2 = t;
482 tangent d = t1 - t2;
483 tangent h(-1, 1);
484 tangent half(-1, 0);
485 UINT qdiff = d.quadrant - 1;
486 for (UINT i = 0; i < qdiff; i++){
487 half.rotate(h);
488 }
489 float s = d.slope;
490 float s1 = 0;
491 if (s > 0){
492 s1 = (sqrt(1 + s*s) - 1) / s;
493 }
494 tangent rest = tangent(-1, 0);
495 rest.slope = s1;
496 tangent r = half + rest;
497 tangent result = r + t1;
498 return result;
499 }
500
501 tangent leftIntermediate(tangent t){
502 tangent t1 = *this;
503 tangent t2 = t;
504 tangent rv(1, 0);
505 tangent tt = t2 + rv;
506 tangent b = t1.bisect(tt);
507 return b;
508 }
509
510 tangent operator-(tangent t){
511 tangent t1 = *this;
512 tangent t2 = t;
513 t2.rotate(t1);
514 tangent result = t2;
515 return result;
516 }
517
518 tangent operator+(tangent t){
519 tangent result(1, 1);
520 result.quadrant = quadrant;
521 result.quadrant += t.quadrant - 1;
522 float s = slope;
523 float tslope = t.slope;
524 if ((s * tslope) == 1) {
525 result.slope = 0;
526 result.quadrant++;
527 }
528 else{
529 result.slope = (s + tslope) / (1 - s * tslope);
530 }
531 if (result.slope < 0) {
532 result.quadrant++;
533 result.slope = -1 / result.slope;
534 }
535 result.quadrant = (result.quadrant - 1) % 4 + 1;
536 return result;
537 }
538
539 bool operator<(tangent t2) {
540 if (quadrant > t2.quadrant) {
541 return false;
542 } else if (quadrant < t2.quadrant) {
543 return true;
544 } else if (slope < t2.slope) {
545 return true;
546 } else {
547 return false;
548 }
549 }
550 bool operator==(tangent t2){
551 if (slope == t2.slope && quadrant == t2.quadrant){
552 return true;
553 }
554 return false;
555 }
556 bool operator!=(tangent t2){
557 return !(*this == t2);
558 }
559 bool operator<=(tangent t2){
560 if (*this < t2 || *this == t2){
561 return true;
562 }
563 return false;
564 }
565 std::string croack() {
566 std::ostringstream r;
567 r << "Slope: " << slope << "\tQuadrant: " << quadrant << std::endl;
568 return r.str();
569 }
570};

798 scale(point p1, point p2){

815 point place(scale s, point m){
816 point r;
817 scale tempScale;
818 tempScale.initScale();
819 float offset;
820 float Scale;
821 if (s.ratio() <= ratio())
822 {
823 offset = s.xSpan() - s.ySpan() / ratio();
824 offset /= 2;
825 tempScale.setMinX(offset + s.minX());
826 tempScale.setMaxX(s.maxX() - offset);
827 tempScale.setMinY(s.minY());
828 tempScale.setMaxY(s.maxY());
829 }
830 else
831 {
832 offset = s.ySpan() - ratio() * s.xSpan();
833 offset /= 2;
834 tempScale.setMinX(s.minX());
835 tempScale.setMaxX(s.maxX());
836 tempScale.setMinY(offset + s.minY());
837 tempScale.setMaxY(s.maxY() - offset);
838 }
839 r.x = m.x - minX();
840 r.y = m.y - minY();
841 r.x /= xSpan();
842 r.y /= ySpan();
843 r.x *= tempScale.xSpan();
844 r.y *= tempScale.ySpan();
845 r.x += tempScale.minX();
846 r.y += tempScale.minY();
847 Scale = tempScale.xSpan() / xSpan();
848 r.radius = Scale * m.radius;
849 return r;
850 }
851
852 void addToScale(point p){
853 if (clear){
854 x = p.x - p.radius;
855 X = p.x + p.radius;
856 y = p.y - p.radius;
857 Y = p.y + p.radius;
858 clear = false;
859 }
860 else{
861 float possib[4] = {
862 p.x - p.radius,
863 p.x + p.radius,
864 p.y - p.radius,
865 p.y + p.radius
866 };
867 for (UINT i = 0; i < 2; i++){
868 if (possib[i] < x){
869 x = possib[i];
870 }
871 else if (possib[i] > X){
872 X = possib[i];
873 }
874 }
875 for (UINT i = 2; i < 4; i++){
876 if (possib[i] < y){
877 y = possib[i];
878 }
879 else if (possib[i] > Y){
880 Y = possib[i];
881 }
882 }
883 }
884 }

980float perimeter(std::vector<point> v, bool close = false)
981{
982 UINT i;
983 float result = 0;
984 float rx, ry;
985 for (i = 0; i < v.size() - 1; i++)
986 {
987 rx = v[i+1].x - v[i].x;
988 ry = v[i+1].y - v[i].y;
989 result += sqrt(rx * rx + ry * ry);
990 }
991 if (close)
992 {
993 rx = v[v.size()-1].x - v[0].x;
994 ry = v[v.size()-1].y - v[0].y;
995 result += sqrt(rx * rx + ry * ry);
996 }
997 return result;
998}

1076class binMap
1077{
1078
1079 int ngroups;
1080 std::vector<std::vector<int> > column;
1081 std::vector<std::vector<std::vector<int> > > row;
1082
1083 signed int firstUnmatched1(std::vector<int> v)
1084 {
1085 /***********************************************************
1086
1087 Returns an integer with the position of the first
1088 unmatched 1. If none is found, the function
1089 returns -1.
1090
1091 @v is the input std::vector to be searched for unmatched 1s
1092
1093 ***********************************************************/
1094
1095 signed int counter = 0;
1096 UINT i;
1097 for (i = 0; i < v.size(); i++)
1098 {
1099
1100 if (v[i] == 1)
1101 {
1102 counter++;
1103 if (counter > 0)
1104 return i;
1105 }
1106 else
1107 {
1108 counter--;
1109 }
1110 }
1111 return -1; // no unmatched @which
1112 }
1113
1114 signed int firstUnmatched0(std::vector<int> v)
1115 {
1116 /***********************************************************
1117
1118 Returns an integer with the position of the first
1119 unmatched 0. If none is found, the function
1120 returns -1.
1121
1122 @v is the input std::vector to be searched for unmatched 0s
1123
1124 ***********************************************************/
1125
1126 int counter;
1127 UINT i, j;
1128 bool ismatched = false;
1129 if (v.size() > 0){
1130 for (i = 0; i < v.size() - 1; i++)
1131 {
1132 counter = 0;
1133 if (v[i] == 0)
1134 {
1135 ismatched = false;
1136 for (j = i + 1; j < v.size(); j++)
1137 {
1138 if (v[j] == 0)
1139 {
1140 counter++;
1141 }
1142 else
1143 {
1144 counter--;
1145 }
1146 if (counter < 0)
1147 ismatched = true;
1148 }
1149 if (!ismatched)
1150 return i;
1151 }
1152 }
1153 if (v[v.size() - 1] == 0)
1154 return (v.size()-1);
1155 }
1156 return -1; // no unmatched @which
1157 }
1158 std::vector<std::vector<int> > getBranches(std::vector<int> v)
1159 {
1160 /***********************************************************
1161
1162 Returns a std::vector containing all of the branches derived
1163 from the input vector. These are obtained by changing to
1164 1 each 0 to the right of the last 1 if the resulting
1165 std::vector has no unmatched 1s. If there are no branches,
1166 the return std::vector is empty.
1167
1168 @v input binary vector
1169
1170 ***********************************************************/
1171
1172 UINT i;
1173 int last1=0;
1174 std::vector<int> tempV;
1175 std::vector<std::vector<int> > result;
1176 for (i = 0; i < v.size(); i++)
1177 {// Get last 1
1178 if (v[i]==1)
1179 last1 = i;
1180 }
1181 for (i = last1 + 1; i < v.size(); i++)
1182 {
1183 tempV = v;
1184 tempV[i] = 1;
1185 if (firstUnmatched1(tempV) == -1)
1186 {
1187 result.push_back(tempV);
1188 }
1189 }
1190 return result;
1191 }
1192
1193 void fillColumn(std::vector<int> v)
1194 {
1195 std::vector<int> result;
1196 int position = 0;
1197 result = v;
1198 position = firstUnmatched0(result);
1199 column.push_back(v);
1200 while (position != -1)
1201 {
1202 result[position] = 1;
1203 column.push_back(result);
1204 position = firstUnmatched0(result);
1205 }
1206 row.push_back(column);
1207 column.clear();
1208 }
1209
1210 void fillRow(std::vector<std::vector<int> > c)
1211 {
1212 UINT i;
1213 std::vector<std::vector<int> > tempc;
1214 for (i = 0; i < c.size(); i++)
1215 {
1216 fillColumn(c[i]);
1217 tempc = getBranches(c[i]);
1218 fillRow(tempc);
1219 }
1220 }
1221
1222public:
1223
1224 friend class borderLine;
1225
1226 binMap(int n)
1227 {
1228 std::vector<int> currentV;
1229 std::vector<std::vector<int> > currentC;
1230 ngroups = n;
1231 currentV = toBin(0, n);
1232 fillColumn(currentV);
1233 currentC = getBranches(currentV);
1234 fillRow(currentC);
1235 }
1236 void textOut()
1237 {
1238 UINT i, j, k;
1239 for (i = 0; i < row.size(); i++)
1240 {
1241 for (j = 0; j < row[i].size(); j++)
1242 {
1243 for (k = 0; k < row[i][j].size(); k++)
1244 {
1245 std::cout << row[i][j][k];
1246 }
1247 std::cout << " ";
1248 }
1249 std::cout << std::endl;
1250 }
1251 }
1252};

1264class decider{
1265 bool finish;
1266 bool canFinish;
1267 bool first;
1268 UINT cyclesWithoutImprovement;
1269 UINT finishAfter;
1270 float bestCompactness;
1271 UINT nAvg;
1272 UINT counter;
1273 UINT ncycles;
1274 UINT mincycles;
1275 float totalCompactness;
1276 float lastCompactness;
1277 float bestUntie;
1278 float wRoom;
1279 bool keep;
1280public:
1281 void setConstants(UINT numberForAverage, UINT numberForStability, float wiggleRoom = 1, UINT minNumberOfCycles = 0){
1282 finish = false;
1283 canFinish = false;
1284 cyclesWithoutImprovement = 0;
1285 nAvg = numberForAverage;
1286 finishAfter = numberForStability;
1287 counter = 0;
1288 totalCompactness = 0;
1289 first = true;
1290 keep = false;
1291 wRoom = wiggleRoom;
1292 mincycles = minNumberOfCycles;
1293 }
1294 void init(){
1295 finish = false;
1296 canFinish = false;
1297 first = true;
1298 cyclesWithoutImprovement = 0;
1299 counter = 0;
1300 ncycles = 0;
1301 totalCompactness = 0;
1302 lastCompactness = 0;
1303 }
1304 void setCanFinish(){
1305 canFinish = true;
1306 if (finishAfter == 0){
1307 finish = true;
1308 }
1309 }
1310 bool keepState(){
1311 return keep;
1312 }
1313 void add(float comp){
1314 if (comp == 0){
1315 finish = true;
1316 }
1317 keep = false;
1318 ncycles++;
1319 if (first){
1320 first = false;
1321 counter++;
1322 bestCompactness = comp;
1323 lastCompactness = comp;
1324 }
1325 if (canFinish){
1326 if (finishAfter == 0){
1327 finish = true;
1328 }
1329 if (comp < (bestCompactness)){
1330 bestCompactness = comp;
1331 keep = true;
1332 cyclesWithoutImprovement = 0;
1333 }
1334 else{
1335 cyclesWithoutImprovement++;
1336 if (cyclesWithoutImprovement > finishAfter){
1337 finish = true;
1338 }
1339 }
1340 }
1341 else{
1342 totalCompactness += comp;
1343 counter++;
1344 if (counter > nAvg){
1345 float newAvg = totalCompactness / ((float)(nAvg));
1346 if (newAvg > (lastCompactness / wRoom) && ncycles > mincycles){
1347 canFinish = true;
1348 }
1349 counter = 1;
1350 totalCompactness = 0;
1351 lastCompactness = newAvg;
1352 }
1353 }
1354 }
1355 UINT viewCounter(){
1356 return counter;
1357 }
1358 float viewLastComp(){
1359 return lastCompactness;
1360 }
1361 UINT viewCanFinish(){
1362 return (UINT) canFinish;
1363 }
1364 UINT viewCyclesWithoutImprovement(){
1365 return cyclesWithoutImprovement;
1366 }
1367
1368 bool finished(){
1369 bool result = finish;
1370 return result;
1371 }
1372
1373};

1754 float rat = test.radius / minRat;

1759 trad = tr;

1771 void setCircles(binMap b, std::vector<float> o, std::vector<std::string> tlabels)
1772 {
1773 UINT i, j;
1774 int n;
1775 int height;
1776 int offset;
1777 float maxw = 0;
1778 point cpoint;
1779 height = b.row[0].size();
1780 scircles.assign((1 << b.ngroups),cpoint);
1781 for (i = 0; i < w.size(); i++)
1782 {
1783 if (w[i] > maxw)
1784 maxw = w[i];
1785 }
1786 for (i = 0; i < b.row.size(); i++)
1787 {
1788 offset = (height - b.row[i].size()) / 2;
1789 for (j = 0; j < b.row[i].size(); j++)
1790 {
1791 n = toInt(b.row[i][j]);
1792 cpoint.n = n;
1793 cpoint.x = 6 * i;
1794 cpoint.y = 6 * (j + offset - 1);
1795 cpoint.radius = 2 * sqrt(w[n] / maxw);
1796 circRadii.push_back(2 * sqrt(origw[n] / maxw));
1797 cpoint.orig = o[n];
1798 circles.push_back(cpoint);
1799 labels.push_back(tlabels[n]);
1800 cpoint.fx = 0;
1801 cpoint.fy = 0;
1802 cpoint.vx = 0;
1803 cpoint.vy = 0;
1804 cpoint.inContact = false;
1805 }
1806 }
1807 for (j = 1; j < circRadii.size(); j++){
1808 if (circRadii[j] > 0 && circRadii[j] < minCircRadius) minCircRadius = circRadii[j];
1809 if (circRadii[j] > 0 && circRadii[j] > maxRadius) maxRadius = circRadii[j];
1810 }
1811 //circles[0].radius = 0;
1812 }

1820 void randomizeCircles(){
1821 UINT gstep = 1;
1822 UINT gridSize = twoPow(ngroups >> 1);
1823 if ((ngroups & 1) > 0){ // Odd number of groups
1824 gridSize = gridSize << 1;
1825 gstep = 2;
1826 }
1827
1828 //std::cout << "gridSize: " << gridSize << "\n";
1829 float xstep = internalScale.xSpan() / ((gridSize + 1));
1830 float ystep = xstep; //internalScale.ySpan() / (gridSize + 1);
1831 //std::cout << "xStep: " << internalScale.xSpan() << "\n";
1832 //std::cout << "yStep: " << ystep << "\n";
1833 std::vector<UINT> order;
1834 for (UINT i = 0; i < circles.size(); i++){
1835 order.push_back(i);
1836 }
1837 std::random_device rd;
1838 if (!fromSignature) seed = rd();
1839 std::mt19937 g(seed);
1840 shuffle(order.begin(), order.end(), g);
1841 UINT sy = 0; UINT sx = 0;
1842 for (UINT i = 0; i < circles.size(); i++){
1843 float cx = (sx + 0.5) * xstep + internalScale.minX();
1844 float cy = (sy + 0.5) * ystep + internalScale.minY();
1845 sx += gstep;
1846 if (sx > gridSize){
1847 sy++;
1848 sx = 0;
1849 }
1850 circles[order[i]].x = cx;
1851 circles[order[i]].y = cy;
1852 }
1853
1854 }

1857 void setPoints(binMap b, UINT ngroup)
1858 {
1859 int i, counter;
1860 int cstart; //placement of first and last point
1861 //depending on ngroup
1862 point cpoint; //point storage
1863 point fpoint; //first point
1864 int height;
1865 int width;
1866 int omyheight; //offset
1867 int myheight;
1868 int isOne;
1869 height = b.row[0].size();
1870 // First point
1871 if (ngroup < (ngroups - 1))
1872 {
1873 cstart = b.ngroups - ngroup - 2;
1874 }
1875 else
1876 {
1877 cstart = ngroups - 1;
1878 }
1879 fpoint.x = -6 * (1 + cstart);
1880 fpoint.y = 6 * (height + 1 + cstart);
1881 internalScale.addToScale(fpoint);
1882 p.push_back(fpoint);
1883 // Variable points
1884 width = b.row.size();
1885 for (i = 0; i < width; i++)
1886 {
1887 cpoint.x = 6 * i - 2;
1888 // mygroup
1889 myheight = b.row[i].size();
1890 omyheight = (height - myheight) / 2; // the diff is always even
1891 isOne = 1;
1892 counter = myheight; // counts the row
1893 if (b.row[i][counter -1][ngroup] == 1)
1894 {
1895 while (isOne == 1)
1896 {
1897 counter--;
1898 if (counter >= 0)
1899 {
1900 isOne = b.row[i][counter][ngroup];
1901 }
1902 else
1903 {
1904 isOne = 0;
1905 }
1906 }
1907 }
1908 else
1909 {
1910 counter--;
1911 }
1912 cpoint.y = 6 * (omyheight + counter) - 3;
1913 internalScale.addToScale(cpoint);
1914 p.push_back(cpoint);
1915 cpoint.x = 6 * i + 2;
1916 internalScale.addToScale(cpoint);
1917 p.push_back(cpoint);
1918 // add circles
1919 }
1920 //last point
1921 cpoint.x = 6 * (width + 1 + cstart);
1922 cpoint.y = 6 * (height + 1 + cstart);
1923 cpoint.mass = POINT_MASS;
1924 internalScale.addToScale(cpoint);
1925 p.push_back(cpoint);
1926 initOlds();
1927 }

1972 point eqforce(point &p0, point &p1, float kattr = 5e-2f)
1973 {
1974 point result;
1975 float radius;
1976 float dx, dy;
1977 float fatt;
1978 float d;
1979 radius = 1.0 * (p0.radius + p1.radius);
1980 float maxrad = p0.radius;
1981 if (p1.radius > maxrad) maxrad = p1.radius;
1982 //radius *= 1.2;
1983 dx = p1.x - p0.x;
1984 dy = p1.y - p0.y;
1985 d = distance(p0.x, p0.y, p1.x, p1.y);
1986 fatt = 0;
1987 if (d > maxrad) fatt = blSettings.sk * kattr * (d - radius);
1988 if (d < maxrad) fatt = -fatt;
1989 fatt /= twoPow(ngroups);
1990 result.fx = dx * fatt;
1991 result.fy = dy * fatt;
1992 p0.fx += result.fx;
1993 p1.fx -= result.fx;
1994 p0.fy += result.fy;
1995 p1.fy -= result.fy;
1996 return result;
1997 }
1998
1999 point selforce(point &p0, point &p1, float kattr = 5e-3f, float radiusFactor = 0)
2000 {
2001 if (kattr == 0){
2002 kattr = 5e-3f;
2003 }
2004 if (p1.radius == 0 || p0.radius == 0){
2005 return p0;
2006 }
2007 float repulsion = blSettings.sk * kattr * 5;
2008 point result;
2009 float factor = (float) getRelationships(p0.n, p1.n) + 1;
2010 float radius = radiusFactor * (p0.radius + p1.radius);
2011 //radius *= 1.2;
2012 float dx = p1.x - p0.x;
2013 float dy = p1.y - p0.y;
2014 float d = distance(p0.x, p0.y, p1.x, p1.y);
2015 float fatt = 0;
2016 if (d > radius) fatt = (factor*factor) * blSettings.sk * kattr * (d-radius) - repulsion;
2017 //if (d < radius) fatt = -blSettings.sk * kattr * (d - radius);
2018 result.fx = dx * fatt/d;
2019 result.fy = dy * fatt/d;
2020 potential += fatt;
2021 p0.fx += result.fx;
2022 p1.fx -= result.fx;
2023 p0.fy += result.fy;
2024 p1.fy -= result.fy;
2025 return result;
2026 }
2027
2028 point selforce2(point &p0, point &p1, float kattr = 5e-4f)
2029 {
2030 if (kattr == 0){
2031 kattr = 5e-4f;
2032 }
2033 if (p1.radius == 0 || p0.radius == 0){
2034 return p0;
2035 }
2036 float repulsion = -kattr;
2037 point result;
2038 //float factor = (float) getRelationships(p0.n, p1.n);
2039 float radius = p0.radius + p1.radius + 4 * blSettings.margin;
2040 //radius *= 1.2;
2041 float dx = p1.x - p0.x;
2042 float dy = p1.y - p0.y;
2043 float d = distance(p0.x, p0.y, p1.x, p1.y);
2044 if (d == 0){
2045 d = 0.01;
2046 }
2047 float fatt = 0;
2048 if (d > radius) fatt = blSettings.sk * kattr * (d-radius) - repulsion;
2049 //if (d < radius) fatt = -blSettings.sk * kattr * (d - radius);
2050 result.fx = dx * fatt/d;
2051 result.fy = dy * fatt/d;
2052 potential += fatt;
2053 p0.fx += result.fx;
2054 p1.fx -= result.fx;
2055 p0.fy += result.fy;
2056 p1.fy -= result.fy;
2057 return result;
2058 }

2085 again = false;
2086 std::vector<point> newbl;

2097 UINT fcirc = 0;

2112 again = true;
2113 fcirc = k + 1;

2115 float t = sqrt(lrad * lrad - h * h);
2116 float d1 = sqrt(dsq1 - h * h);

2118 c.flags = setFlag(c.flags, USED);

2126 pst2.n = k;

2129 // Option 1

2133 newp.flags = setFlag(newp.flags, DELME);
2134 newp.n = k;
2135 //Option 2
2136 tr = tp + lft;

2138 newpa.flags = setFlag(newpa.flags, DO_NOT_EMBELLISH);
2139 newpa.flags = setFlag(newpa.flags, DELME);
2140 newpa.n = k;
2141
2142 if (inside){
2143 newbl.push_back(newpa);
2144 newblAlt.push_back(newp);
2145 }
2146 else{
2147 newbl.push_back(newp);
2148 newblAlt.push_back(newpa);
2149 }
2150
2151 newbl.push_back(pst2);
2152 newblAlt.push_back(pst2);
2153 // Close the bl for the next cycle
2154 for (UINT l = j+1; l < bl[i].size(); l++){

2156 newblAlt.push_back(bl[i][l]);
2157 }

2159 bl[i] = newbl;
2160 UINT cn = c.n;
2161 std::vector<int> belong = toBin(cn, bl.size());

2164 //writeSVG("/home/vqf/proyectos/nVenn2/error.svg");
2165 bl[i].clear();

2170 }

2174 }

2178 }

2485 float getArea(){
2486 float area = 0;
2487 for (UINT i = 0; i < bl.size(); i++){
2488 for (UINT j = 0; j < bl[i].size(); j++){
2489 point p1 = bl[i][j];
2490 UINT np2 = nextPoint(i, j);
2491 point p2 = bl[i][np2];
2492 float dx = p2.x - p1.x;
2493 float dy = p2.y - p1.y;
2494 area += p1.y * dx + dx * dy / 2;
2495 }
2496 }
2497 return area;
2498 }

2511 float compactness(){
2512 float result = 0;
2513 for (UINT i = 0; i < circles.size() - 1; i++){
2514 if (circles[i].radius > 0){
2515 for (UINT j = i + 1; j < circles.size(); j++){
2516 if (circles[j].radius > 0){
2517 UINT n = getRelationships(i, j);
2518 if (n > 0){
2519 float sqd = sqDistance(circles[i], circles[j]);
2520 result += log(sqd) + log(n);
2521 }
2522 }
2523 }
2524 }
2525 }
2526 return result;
2527 }

2529 UINT nextLeftmostPoint(UINT ngroup, UINT n1, UINT n2){
2530 point anchor = circles[n1];
2531 if (n1 == n2){
2532 anchor.x -= 1;
2533 }
2534 groupIterator git(circles, ngroup, n2);
2535 git.nxt();
2536 bool first = true;
2537 ccwangle best(anchor, circles[n2], anchor);
2538 UINT result = git.val();
2539 while (!git.isFinished()){
2540 UINT n3 = git.val();
2541 if (n3 != n2){
2542 ccwangle test(anchor, circles[n2], circles[n3]);
2543 if (first || best < test){
2544 first = false;
2545 best = test;
2546 result = n3;
2547 }
2548 }
2549 git.nxt();
2550 }
2551 return result;
2552 }

2742 std::vector<point> getSetBoundaries(UINT groups, float air = 0, bool onlyCircles = false){

2746 std::vector<point> result;
2747 //i = ci.nxt();

2751 if (fst){

2753 ul.x = circles[i].x; ul.y = circles[i].y;

2757 else{
2758 if (circles[i].x < result[0].x){
2759 result[0].x = circles[i].x;

2761 if (circles[i].y < result[0].y){

2764 if (circles[i].x > result[1].x){
2765 result[1].x = circles[i].x;

2768 result[1].y = circles[i].y;

2775 for (UINT k = 0; k < bl.size(); k++){

2778 if (bl[k][j].x < result[0].x){
2779 result[0].x = bl[k][j].x;

2781 if (bl[k][j].y < result[0].y){
2782 result[0].y = bl[k][j].y;

2784 if (bl[k][j].x > result[1].x){
2785 result[1].x = bl[k][j].x;
2786 }
2787 if (bl[k][j].y > result[1].y){
2788 result[1].y = bl[k][j].y;
2789 }
2790 }
2791 }
2792 }
2793 }
2794 result[0].x -= air;
2795 result[0].y -= air;
2796 result[1].x += air;
2797 result[1].y += air;
2798 return result;
2799 }

2973 std::vector<UINT> sampleUINT(std::vector<UINT> from, UINT n, std::mt19937 *gen){
2974 UINT nc = from.size() - 1;
2975 std::vector<UINT> cp = from;
2976 std::vector<UINT> result;
2977 std::set<UINT> offsets;
2978 for (UINT i = 0; i < n; i++){
2979 std::uniform_int_distribution<UINT> distrib(0, nc);
2980 UINT ni = distrib(*gen);
2981 std::set<UINT>::iterator it;
2982 for (it = offsets.begin(); it != offsets.end(); it++){
2983 UINT v = *it;
2984 if (v <= ni){
2985 ni++;
2986 }
2987 }
2988 offsets.insert(ni);
2989 result.push_back(from[ni]);
2990 nc--;
2991 }
2992 return result;
2993 }

3007 float MHCompact(){
3008 UINT nstep = 2; // Number of circles exchanged in each step
3009 UINT maxSteps = 100000;
3010 std::random_device rd; // Will be used to obtain a seed for the random number engine
3011 std::mt19937 gen(rd()); // Standard mersenne_twister_engine seeded with rd()
3012 std::uniform_real_distribution<float> alpha(0.0, 1.0);
3013 UINT cyclesWithoutImprovement = 0;
3014 float bestCompactness = compactness();
3015 std::vector<UINT> existingCircles = ncircles();
3016 UINT counter = 0;
3017 while (cyclesWithoutImprovement < 1000 && counter < maxSteps){
3018 std::vector<UINT> exch = sampleUINT(existingCircles, nstep, &gen);
3019 UINT ci = exch[0];
3020 UINT cj = exch[1];
3021 tolog("Exchanging " + toString(ci) + " with " + toString(cj) + "\n");
3022 swapCoords(ci, cj);
3023 float newCompactness = compactness();
3024 tolog("Old comp: " + toString(bestCompactness) + "\tNew comp: " + toString(newCompactness) + "\n");
3025 if (newCompactness < bestCompactness){
3026 cyclesWithoutImprovement = 0;
3027 bestCompactness = newCompactness;
3028 }
3029 else{
3030 float decd = alpha(gen);
3031 float rtio = bestCompactness / newCompactness;
3032 tolog("Decider: " + toString(decd) + ", " + "Ration: " + toString(rtio) + "\n");
3033 if (decd > rtio){
3034 swapCoords(ci, cj);
3035 tolog("Bailed\n");
3036 }
3037 cyclesWithoutImprovement++;
3038 }
3039 counter++;
3040 }
3041 return bestCompactness;
3042 }
3043
3044 float MHCrosses(){
3045 UINT nstep = 2; // Number of circles exchanged in each step
3046 UINT maxSteps = 10000;
3047 std::random_device rd; // Will be used to obtain a seed for the random number engine
3048 std::mt19937 gen(rd()); // Standard mersenne_twister_engine seeded with rd()
3049 std::uniform_real_distribution<float> alpha(0.0, 1.0);
3050 UINT cyclesWithoutImprovement = 0;
3051 fixTopology();
3052 float bestCrossings = countCrossings();
3053 std::vector<UINT> existingCircles = ncircles();
3054 UINT counter = 0;
3055 while (cyclesWithoutImprovement < 500 && counter < maxSteps){
3056 std::vector<UINT> exch = sampleUINT(existingCircles, nstep, &gen);
3057 UINT ci = exch[0];
3058 UINT cj = exch[1];
3059 tolog("Exchanging " + toString(ci) + " with " + toString(cj) + "\n");
3060 swapCoords(ci, cj);
3061 fixTopology();
3062 if (checkTopol()){
3063 swapCoords(ci, cj);
3064 }
3065 else{
3066 float newCrossings = countCrossings();
3067 tolog("Old cross: " + toString(bestCrossings) + "\tNew cross: " + toString(newCrossings) + "\n");
3068 if (newCrossings < bestCrossings){
3069 cyclesWithoutImprovement = 0;
3070 bestCrossings = newCrossings;
3071 }
3072 else{
3073 float decd = alpha(gen);
3074 float rtio = bestCrossings / newCrossings;
3075 tolog("Decider: " + toString(decd) + ", " + "Ration: " + toString(rtio) + "\n");
3076 if (decd > rtio){
3077 swapCoords(ci, cj);
3078 tolog("Bailed\n");
3079 }
3080 cyclesWithoutImprovement++;
3081 }
3082 counter++;
3083 }
3084 }
3085 return bestCrossings;
3086 }

3103 UINT furthestPoint(){
3104 UINT result = 0;

3111 for (UINT j = 0; j < circles.size(); j++){

3119 }

3124 first = false;

3167 float (borderLine::*countFunct)(), float (borderLine::*untieFunct)(),
3168 bool logit = false){
3169 float untie = (this->*untieFunct)();
3170 //float startComp = (this->*countFunct)();
3171 //opt->setBestCompactness(startComp);
3172 displayFloat("BEST", opt->getBestCompactness());
3173 if (opt->hasEnded()){
3174 opt->startCycle();

3176 UINT n = opt->getCandidate();
3177 tolog("Next candidate: " + toString(circles[n].n) + "\n");
3178 if (n == 0){
3179 opt->endCycle();
3180 resetOptimize();
3181 opt->startCycle();
3182 }
3183 //std::cout << circles[n].n << std::endl;
3184 }
3185 else{
3186 UINT candidate = opt->getCandidate();
3187 displayUINT("CANDIDATE", candidate);
3188 if (candidate > 0){
3189 UINT i = opt->getCounter();
3190 if (i != candidate && circles[i].radius > 0){
3191 swapCoords(i, candidate);
3192 //tolog("Checking " + toString(circles[i].n) + " with " + toString(opt->getBestCompactness()) + "\n");
3193 //std::cout << circles[i].n << ", ";
3194 fixTopology();
3195 //writeSVG("starting.svg");
3196 if (checkTopol()){
3197 tolog("Undo on checkTopol\n");
3198 swapCoords(i, candidate);
3199 }
3200 else{
3201 float newComp = (this->*countFunct)();
3202 if (newComp < opt->getBestCompactness()){
3203 opt->setBestCompactness(newComp);
3204 tolog("Swapping " + toString(i) + " with " + toString(candidate) + " -> " + toString(newComp) + "\n");
3205 //std::cout << "Swapping " << i << " with " << candidate << " -> " << newComp << std::endl;
3206 }
3207 else if (newComp == opt->getBestCompactness()){
3208 float newUntie = (this->*untieFunct)();
3209 tolog("Prev untie: " + toString(untie) + ", new untie: " + toString(newUntie) + "\n");
3210 opt->setUntie();
3211 if (newUntie > untie){
3212 swapCoords(i, candidate);
3213 tolog("Did not swap on untie\n");
3214 }
3215 }
3216 else{
3217 swapCoords(i, candidate);
3218 }
3219 }
3220 }
3221 }
3222 opt->next();
3223 if (opt->getCounter() >= circles.size()){
3224 opt->endCycle();
3225 }
3226 }
3227 return opt->getBestCompactness();

3297 point spring(point &p0, point &p1, float dampen = 0, float springK = -1)
3298 {
3299 if (springK < 0){
3300 springK = blSettings.sk;
3301 }
3302 point result;
3303 float dx = p1.x - p0.x;
3304 float dy = p1.y - p0.y;
3305 result.fx = springK * dx;
3306 result.fy = springK * dy;
3307 p0.fx += result.fx - dampen * p0.vx * p0.vx * p0.vx;
3308 p1.fx -= result.fx + dampen * p1.vx * p1.vx * p1.vx;
3309 p0.fy += result.fy - dampen * p0.vy * p0.vy * p0.vy;
3310 p1.fy -= result.fy + dampen * p1.vy * p1.vy * p1.vy;
3311 return result;
3312 }

3525 point rope(point &circ, point &p0, point &p1)
3526 {
3527 float a, b;
3528 float d;
3529 point result;
3530 point zero;
3531 point virt;
3532 float d0, d1;
3533 a = (p1.y - p0.y)/(p1.x - p0.x);
3534 b = p0.y - a * p0.x;
3535 virt.x = ((circ.x + a*circ.y - a * b)/(a*a + 1));
3536 virt.y = (a * circ.x + a*a*circ.y + b)/(a*a + 1);
3537 d0 = distance(p0.x, p0.y, virt.x, virt.y) /
3538 distance(p0.x, p0.y, p1.x, p1.y);
3539 d1 = distance(p1.x, p1.y, virt.x, virt.y) /
3540 distance(p0.x, p0.y, p1.x, p1.y);
3541 float td = d0 + d1;
3542 float rd = d0 / td;
3543 virt.vx = p0.vx + (p1.vx-p0.vx) * rd;
3544 virt.fx = p0.fx + (p1.fx-p0.fx) * rd;
3545 virt.vy = p0.vy + (p1.vy-p0.vy) * rd;
3546 virt.fy = p0.fy + (p1.fy-p0.fy) * rd;
3547 virt.mass = p0.mass;
3548 d = distance(circ.x, circ.y, virt.x, virt.y);
3549 if (d < circ.radius && isInside(p0, p1, virt))
3550 {
3551 result = contact(circ, virt);
3552 p0.fx = d1 * virt.fx * rd;
3553 p0.fy = d1 * virt.fy * rd;
3554 p1.fx = d0 * virt.fx * rd;
3555 p1.fy = d0 * virt.fy * rd;
3556 //attention(p0.x, p0.y, p0.x+1e-3*p0.fx, p0.y+1e-3*p0.fy);
3557 //attention(p1.x, p1.y, p1.x+1e-3*p1.fx, p1.y+1e-3*p1.fy);
3558 //Sleep(100);
3559 return result;
3560 }
3561 else
3562 {
3563 return zero;
3564 }
3565 }

3761 next = true;
3762 }

3768 void setForces3()
3769 {
3770 UINT i, j, k;
3771 point p1, p2;
3772 /*******/
3773 for (i = 0; i < bl.size(); i++)
3774 {
3775 for (j = 0; j < bl[i].size(); j++)
3776 {
3777 bl[i][j].cancelForce = false; // Reuse to point those points inside a circle
3778 k = closestToSurf(i,j);
3779 float rad = bl[i][j].radius + circles[k].radius + blSettings.marginScale * i;
3780 float prad = distance(bl[i][j].x, bl[i][j].y, circles[k].x, circles[k].y);
3781 bool st = sticking(i, j, k);
3782 if (st){
3783 float rat = rad / prad;
3784 bl[i][j].x = circles[k].x + rat * (bl[i][j].x - circles[k].x);
3785 bl[i][j].y = circles[k].y + rat * (bl[i][j].y - circles[k].y);
3786 bl[i][j].cancelForce = true;
3787 }
3788 }
3789 // Soften borders
3790 for (j = 0; j < bl[i].size(); j++)
3791 {

3815 int closestToSurf(UINT i, UINT j){

3819 while (circles[result].radius == 0 && result < circles.size()){
3820 result++;
3821 }
3822 float mindist = distance(P.x, P.y, circles[result].x, circles[result].y) - circles[result].radius;
3823 UINT k = result;
3824 while (k < circles.size()){
3825 float dst = distance(P.x, P.y, circles[k].x, circles[k].y) - circles[k].radius;
3826 if (dst < mindist){
3827 mindist = dst;
3828 result = circles[k].n;
3829 }
3830 k++;
3831 }
3832 return result;
3833 }

3895 void limitVel(point &P, float maxv)
3896 {
3897 float f;
3898 f = P.vx * P.vx + P.vy * P.vy;
3899 if (f > maxv*maxv)
3900 {
3901 f = sqrt(f);
3902 P.vx *= maxv/f;
3903 P.vy *= maxv/f;
3904 //attention(P.x, P.y);
3905 }
3906 }
3907
3908 void limitForce(point &P, float maxf)
3909 {
3910 float f;
3911 f = P.fx * P.fx + P.fy * P.fy;
3912 if (f > maxf*maxf)
3913 {
3914 f = sqrt(f);
3915 P.fx *= maxf/f;
3916 P.fy *= maxf/f;
3917 }
3918 }

4251 point getCross(point p1, point p2, point p3, point p4){
4252 point result;
4253 if (std::max(p1.x, p2.x) >= std::min(p3.x, p4.x) &&
4254 std::max(p1.y, p2.y) >= std::min(p3.y, p4.y) &&
4255 std::min(p1.x, p2.x) <= std::max(p3.x, p4.x) &&
4256 std::min(p1.y, p2.y) <= std::max(p3.y, p4.y)){
4257 if (p2.x == p1.x){
4258 result.x = p1.x;
4259 result.y = p3.y + (result.x - p3.x) * (p4.y - p3.y) / (p4.x - p3.x);
4260 }
4261 else if (p4.x == p3.x){
4262 result.x = p3.x;
4263 result.y = p1.y + (result.x - p1.x) * (p2.y - p1.y) / (p2.x - p1.x);
4264 }
4265 else{
4266 float m1 = (p2.y - p1.y) / (p2.x - p1.x);
4267 float m3 = (p4.y - p3.y) / (p4.x - p3.x);
4268 result.x = (p3.y - m3 * p3.x - p1.y + m1 * p1.x) / (m1 - m3);
4269 result.y = p1.y + m1 * (result.x - p1.x);
4270 }
4271 }
4272 return result;
4273 }
4274
4286 crossResult cross(point p1, point p2, point p3, point p4){
4287 crossResult result = doesnotcross;
4288 if (std::max(p1.x, p2.x) >= std::min(p3.x, p4.x) &&
4289 std::max(p1.y, p2.y) >= std::min(p3.y, p4.y) &&
4290 std::min(p1.x, p2.x) <= std::max(p3.x, p4.x) &&
4291 std::min(p1.y, p2.y) <= std::max(p3.y, p4.y)){
4292 if (p1 == p3 || p2 == p3){
4293 return crosses;
4294 }
4295 if (p2 == p4 || p1 == p4){
4296 return doesnotcross;
4297 }
4298 tangent t1 = tangent(p1, p3);
4299 tangent t2 = tangent(p3, p2);
4300 tangent t3 = tangent(p2, p4);
4301 tangent t4 = tangent(p4, p1);
4302 t2.rotate(t1);
4303 t3.rotate(t1);
4304 t4.rotate(t1);
4305 tangent tz = tangent(-1, 0);
4306 if (t2 == tz){
4307 result = doesnotcross;
4308 }
4309 else if (t3 == t4){
4310 result = cont;
4311 }
4312 else{
4313 if (((t2 <= t3) && (t3 <= t4)) ||
4314 ((t3 <= t2) && (t4 <= t3))){
4315 result = crosses;
4316 }
4317 }
4318 //blSettings.cycleInfo += "Tangents: \n" + t1.croack() + t2.croack() + t3.croack() + t4.croack();
4319 }
4320 return result;
4321 }

4491UINT getRelationships(UINT o, UINT t){
4492 UINT i = std::min(o, t);
4493 UINT j = std::max(o, t);
4494 if (i == j){
4495 return 0;
4496 }
4497 UINT r = 0;
4498 UINT N = circles.size();
4499 i++;
4500 UINT row = ((2*i-2) * N - i * i + i) / 2;
4501 r = row + j - i;
4502 return relationships[r];
4503}

4628 point place(scale s, point m)
4629 {
4630 point r;
4631 scale tempScale;
4632 tempScale.initScale();
4633 float offset;
4634 float Scale;
4635 if (s.ratio() <= internalScale.ratio())
4636 {
4637 offset = s.xSpan() - s.ySpan() / internalScale.ratio();
4638 offset /= 2;
4639 tempScale.setMinX(offset + s.minX());
4640 tempScale.setMaxX(s.maxX() - offset);
4641 tempScale.setMinY(s.minY());
4642 tempScale.setMaxY(s.maxY());
4643 }
4644 else
4645 {
4646 offset = s.ySpan() - internalScale.ratio() * s.xSpan();
4647 offset /= 2;
4648 tempScale.setMinX(s.minX());
4649 tempScale.setMaxX(s.maxX());
4650 tempScale.setMinY(offset + s.minY());
4651 tempScale.setMaxY(s.maxY() - offset);
4652 }
4653 r.x = m.x - internalScale.minX();
4654 r.y = m.y - internalScale.minY();
4655 r.x /= internalScale.xSpan();
4656 r.y /= internalScale.ySpan();
4657 r.x *= tempScale.xSpan();
4658 r.y *= tempScale.ySpan();
4659 r.x += tempScale.minX();
4660 r.y += tempScale.minY();
4661 Scale = tempScale.xSpan() / internalScale.xSpan();
4662 r.radius = Scale * m.radius;
4663 return r;
4664 }

4735 float minCircDist(){
4736 UINT flg = twoPow(ngroups) - 1;
4737 groupIterator ci(circles, 0, 0, flg);
4738 UINT fst = ci.val();
4739 UINT scnd = ci.nxt();
4740 float r = sqDistance(circles[fst], circles[scnd]);
4741 ci = groupIterator(circles, 0, 0, flg);
4742 groupIterator ci2(circles, 0, 0, flg);
4743 while (!ci.isFinished()){
4744 UINT v = ci.val();
4745 ci2.reset(v);
4746 while (!ci2.isFinished()){
4747 UINT w = ci2.nxt();
4748 if (v != w){
4749 float nr = sqDistance(circles[v], circles[w]);
4750 if (nr < r){
4751 r = nr;
4752 }
4753 }
4754 }
4755 ci.nxt();
4756 }
4757
4758 float result = sqrt(r);
4759 return result;
4760 }

4806 void centerScene(){
4807 float xmax = internalScale.maxX();
4808 float xmin = internalScale.minX();
4809 float ymax = internalScale.maxY();
4810 float ymin = internalScale.minY();
4811 float deltax = (xmax + xmin) / 2;
4812 float deltay = (ymax + ymin) / 2;
4813 for (UINT i = 0; i < bl.size(); i++){
4814 for (UINT j = 0; j < bl[i].size(); j++){
4815 bl[i][j].x -= deltax;
4816 bl[i][j].y -= deltay;
4817 internalScale.addToScale(bl[i][j]);
4818 }
4819 }
4820 for (UINT i = 0; i < circles.size(); i++){
4821 if (circles[i].radius > 0){
4822 circles[i].x -= deltax;
4823 circles[i].y -= deltay;
4824 internalScale.addToScale(circles[i]);
4825 }
4826 }
4827 resetScale();
4828 }

4830 void rotateScene(float alpha){
4831 centerScene();
4832 float cosa = std::cos(alpha);
4833 float sina = std::sin(alpha);
4834 std::vector<std::vector<point>> newbl;
4835 std::vector<point> newcirc;
4836 for (UINT i = 0; i < bl.size(); i++){
4837 newbl.push_back({});
4838 for (UINT j = 0; j < bl[i].size(); j++){
4839 point t;
4840 t.x = cosa * bl[i][j].x + sina * (bl[i][j].y);
4841 t.y = -sina * bl[i][j].x + cosa * (bl[i][j].y);
4842 newbl[i].push_back(t);
4843 }
4844 }
4845 for (UINT i = 0; i < circles.size(); i++){
4846 point t = circles[i];
4847 t.x = cosa * circles[i].x + sina * (circles[i].y);
4848 t.y = -sina * circles[i].x + cosa * (circles[i].y);
4849 newcirc.push_back(t);
4850 }
4851 bl = newbl;
4852 circles = newcirc;
4853 resetScale();
4854 }

4858 UINT cnt = 0;
4859 tosolve.clearScene();
4860 tosolve.setBackgroundGravity();
4861 tosolve.setRodStiffness(1e5);

4865 for (UINT i = 0; i < bl.size(); i++){
4866 UINT lp = cnt;
4867 for (UINT j = 0; j < bl[i].size(); j++){
4868 //bl[i][j].flags = bl[i][j].flags | INGRAVID;
4869 bl[i][j].flags = bl[i][j].flags | GHOST;
4870 tosolve.addPointP(&(bl[i][j]));
4871 sceneTranslator.push_back(bl[i][j].n);
4872 tosolve.addLink(cnt + lp, cnt + j, springK);
4873 lp = j;
4874 pairDistances.push_back(cushion * (float) level);
4875 }
4876 tosolve.addLink(cnt + lp, cnt, springK);
4877 cnt += lp + 1;
4878 level++;
4879 }
4880 level *= 2;
4881 for (UINT i = 0; i < circles.size(); i++){
4882 if (circles[i].radius > 0){
4883 tosolve.addPointP(&(circles[i]));
4884 sceneTranslator.push_back(circles[i].n);
4885 pairDistances.push_back(cushion * (float) level);
4886 }
4887 }
4888 tosolve.setCushions(pairDistances);
4889 if (blSettings.part){
4890 setGravityPartitions();
4891 }
4892 tosolve.setPseudoGravity(true);
4893 }

4935 void scSolve(){
4936 blSettings.dt = tosolve.solve(blSettings.dt, resetV);
4937 bool incorrect = checkTopol();
4938 while (incorrect){
4939 restorePrevState();
4940 evaluation.init();
4941 //tolog(_L_ + "Bad topol\n");
4942 udt.report();
4943 if (blSettings.dt < blSettings.mindt){
4944 tolog(_L_ + "Cannot solve topol problems\n");
4945 toSVG();
4946 setError("Cannot solve topol problems");
4947 }
4948 blSettings.dt = udt.cdt();
4949 //tolog(_L_ + "Bad topol: " + toString(udt.cdt()) + "\n");
4950 tosolve.solve(blSettings.dt, resetV);
4951 incorrect = checkTopol();
4952 }
4953 if (blCounter == 0){
4954 setPrevState();
4955 }
4956 if (deciderCounter.isMax()){
4957 setPrevState();
4958 udt.poke();
4959 blSettings.dt = udt.cdt();
4960 }
4961 if (blSettings.optimize && keepDistCounter.isMax()){
4962 keepDist(avgStartDist);
4963 if (checkTopol()){
4964 writeSVG("error.svg");
4965 listOutsiders();
4966 tolog(_L_ + "Break on KeepDist\n");
4967 restorePrevState();
4968 }
4969 else{
4970 setSecureState();
4971 }
4972 }
4973 resetScale();
4974 resetCircleRadius();
4975 float d = (this->*currentMeasure)();
4976 evaluation.add(d);
4977 float mfsq = std::log10(tosolve.getMaxFsq());
4978 float mvsq = std::log10(tosolve.getMaxVsq());
4979 float mdsq = std::log10(tosolve.getMaxDsq());
4980 displayFloat("EVALUATE", d);
4981 displayFloat("LASTEVALUATE", evaluation.viewLastComp());
4982 if (blSettings.optimize){
4983 if (evaluation.keepState() && sensible()){
4984 setBestSoFar();
4985 }
4986 }
4987 displayFloat("DT", blSettings.dt);
4988 displayFloat("SIMTIME", tosolve.simTime());
4989 //displayFloat("MAXV", mvsq);
4990 //displayFloat("MAXF", mfsq);
4991 displayUINT("COUNTER", evaluation.viewCounter());
4992 displayUINT("CANFINISH", evaluation.viewCanFinish());
4993 displayUINT("CWI", evaluation.viewCyclesWithoutImprovement());
4994 //displayUINT("DECIDER", deciderCounter);
4995 blCounter++;
4996 deciderCounter++;
4997 keepDistCounter++;
4998 blSettings.ncycles++;
4999 }

5122 void restoreBl(std::string dataFile){
5123 loadSignature(signature);
5124 std::istringstream vFile;
5125 std::string line;
5126 vFile.str(dataFile);
5127 bool sane = true;
5128 std::string errorstr;
5129 std::vector<std::vector<point>>newbl;
5130 newbl.clear();
5131 UINT state = 0;
5132 std::string all;
5133 for (std::string line; std::getline(vFile, line);){
5134 all += exchangeChar(line, '\n', 0x00);
5135 }
5136 std::istringstream sline(all);
5137 std::string el;
5138 std::getline(sline, el, ';');
5139 if (el == "F"){
5140 std::getline(sline, el, ';');
5141 //std::cout << el;
5142 //currentStep = (UINT) atoi(el.c_str());
5143 }
5144 else{
5145 sane = false;
5146 errorstr += "Failed first step. ";
5147 }
5148 std::getline(sline, el, ';');
5149 if (el == "L"){
5150 while (el != "" && el != "C"){
5151 if (el == "L"){
5152 newbl.push_back({});
5153 std::getline(sline, el, ';');
5154 }
5155 UINT ind = newbl.size() - 1;
5156 while (el != "" && el != "C" && el != "L"){
5157 float cx = std::atof(el.c_str());
5158 std::getline(sline, el, ';');
5159 float cy = std::atof(el.c_str());
5160 point p(cx, cy);
5161 newbl[ind].push_back(p);
5162 std::getline(sline, el, ';');
5163 }
5164 }
5165 }
5166 std::vector<point> newcircles;
5167 if (el == "C"){ // There should be a fixed number of circles
5168 for (UINT i = 0; i < twoPow(newbl.size()); i++){
5169 point p;
5170 std::getline(sline, el, ';');
5171 p.x = std::atof(el.c_str());
5172 std::getline(sline, el, ';');
5173 p.y = std::atof(el.c_str());
5174 std::getline(sline, el, ';');
5175 p.radius = std::atof(el.c_str());
5176 std::getline(sline, el, ';');
5177 p.n = (UINT) std::atoi(el.c_str());
5178 std::getline(sline, el, ';');
5179 p.orig = (UINT) std::atoi(el.c_str());
5180 newcircles.push_back(p);
5181 }
5182 }
5183 else{
5184 sane = false;
5185 errorstr += "Failed circles. ";
5186 }
5187 std::getline(sline, el, ';');
5188 if (sane){
5189 nvenn sel = nvenn();
5190 for (UINT i = 0; i < newbl.size(); i++){
5191 if (el == "S" || el == ""){
5192 std::string sn;
5193 std::unordered_set<std::string> els;
5194 std::getline(sline, el, ';');
5195 sn = el;
5196 std::getline(sline, el, ';');
5197 while (el != "" && el != "S"){
5198 els.insert(el);
5199 std::getline(sline, el, ';');
5200 }
5201 sel.addSet(sn, sel.asVector(els));
5202 }
5203 else{
5204 sane = false;
5205 }
5206 }
5207 std::string tovenn = sel.getCode();
5208 std::vector<std::string> setNames = getNames(tovenn);
5209 std::vector<float> tw = getWeights(tovenn);
5210 std::vector<std::string> vd;
5211 vd.assign(tw.size(), "");
5212 init(setNames, tw, vd);
5213 setElements = sel.clone();
5214 savedState.bl_secure.clear();
5215 savedState.bl_old10.clear();
5216 bl.clear();
5217 circles.clear();
5218 for (UINT i = 0; i < newcircles.size(); i++){
5219 circles.push_back(newcircles[i].clone());
5220 internalScale.addToScale(newcircles[i]);
5221 }
5222 for (UINT i = 0; i < newbl.size(); i++){
5223 bl.push_back({});
5224 for (UINT j = 0; j < newbl[i].size(); j++){
5225 bl[i].push_back(newbl[i][j].clone());
5226 }
5227 }
5228 blSettings.doCheckTopol = true;
5229 resetScale();
5230 }
5231 else{
5232 error = true;
5233 errorMessage = "Malformed save string: " + errorstr;
5234 std::cout << "insane" << std::endl;
5235 }
5236
5237 }

5241 vd.assign(origw.size(), "");
5242 nvenn keep = setElements.clone();
5243 bl.clear();

5342 return "";
5343 }
5344 std::stringstream r;
5345 for (UINT i = 0; i < (arr.size() - 1); i++){
5346 r << arr[i] << interm;

5348 r << arr[arr.size() - 1];
5349 return r.str();

5754 {
5755 pstemp = place(ps, bl[i][j]);
5756 tst = vformat("%f %f", pstemp.x, pstemp.y);
5757 pstext.addLine(tst);
5758 }
5759 tst = (std::string) "]";
5760 pstext.addLine(tst);
5761 tst = vformat("/set%d exch def", i + 1);
5762 pstext.addLine(tst);
5763 tst = vformat("set%d minmax", i + 1);
5764 pstext.addLine(tst);
5765 pstext.addLine(" ");
5766 }
5767 pstext.addLine(" ");
5768
5769 // Draw sets
5770 pstext.addLine("%Begin program");
5771 pstext.addLine(" ");
5772
5773 UINT offset = 0;
5774 for (i = 0; i < ngroups; i++)
5775 {
5776 pstext.addLine("gsave");
5777 tst = vformat("set%d topath", i+1);
5778 pstext.addLine(tst);
5779 pstext.addLine("clip");
5780 tst = vformat("%f %f %f %u %u colorpattern", colors[i].red,
5781 colors[i].green, colors[i].blue, offset, offset);
5782 pstext.addLine(tst);
5783 pstext.addLine("grestore");
5784 offset++;
5785 }
5786 pstext.addLine(" ");
5787
5788 for (i = 0; i < ngroups; i++)
5789 {
5790 tst = vformat("%f %f %f set%d showline", colors[i].red,
5791 colors[i].green, colors[i].blue, i+1);
5792 pstext.addLine(tst);
5793 }
5794 pstext.addLine(" ");
5795
5796 /****Draw circles*/
5797 for (i = 0; i < circles.size(); i++){
5798 if (circles[i].mass > 0){
5799 pstemp = place(ps, circles[i]);
5800 pstext.addLine("newpath");
5801 if (pstemp.x > ps.minX() && pstemp.x < ps.maxX()){
5802 tst = vformat("%f %f %f 0 360 arc", pstemp.x,
5803 pstemp.y, pstemp.radius);
5804 pstext.addLine(tst);
5805 pstext.addLine("0.2 setlinewidth");
5806 pstext.addLine("1 0 0 setrgbcolor");
5807 pstext.addLine("stroke");
5808 }
5809 }
5810 }
5811 /*****/
5812 pstext.addLine("showpage");
5813 return pstext;
5814 }

6135 void interpolateToDist(float pDist){
6136 if (pDist <= 0){
6137 pDist = 1;
6138 }
6139
6140 for (UINT i = 0; i < bl.size(); i++){
6141 std::vector<point>tempbl;
6142 float pointDist = pDist;
6143 if (bl[i].size() < 5){
6144 pointDist = pDist / 10;
6145 }
6146 for(UINT j = 0; j < bl[i].size(); j++){
6147 point current = bl[i][j];
6148 point nxt = bl[i][nextPoint(i, j)];
6149 float d = distance(current.x, current.y, nxt.x, nxt.y);
6150 UINT interpoints = ceil(d / pointDist);
6151 if (interpoints == 0)
6152 interpoints = 1;
6153 float dx = (float)(nxt.x - current.x);
6154 dx = dx / interpoints;
6155 float dy = (float)(nxt.y - current.y);
6156 dy = dy / interpoints;
6157 //tolog(toString(__LINE__) + "\n" + "Current: " + current.croack());
6158 for (UINT k = 0; k < interpoints; k++){
6159 point tempPoint;
6160 tempPoint.x = current.x + (k * dx);
6161 tempPoint.y = current.y + (k * dy);
6162 tempPoint.mass = POINT_MASS;
6163 //tolog(toString(__LINE__) + "\n" + "Interp: " + tempPoint.croack());
6164 tempbl.push_back(tempPoint);
6165 }
6166 //tolog(toString(__LINE__) + "\n" + "Next: " + nxt.croack());
6167 }
6168 bl[i] = tempbl;
6169 }
6170 avgStartDist = pDist;
6171 attachScene();
6172 }
6173
6174 void interpolate(UINT npoints)
6175 {
6176 UINT i, j, k;
6177 float dx, dy;
6178 float perim;
6179 float segment;
6180 UINT interpoints;
6181 point startPoint;
6182 point endPoint;
6183 point tempPoint;
6184 std::vector<point> tempv;
6185 std::vector<std::vector<point> > tempbl;
6186 npoints += (UINT) bl[0].size();
6187 for (i = 0; i < bl.size(); i++)
6188 {
6189 perim = perimeter(bl[i], true);
6190 nPointsMin = (UINT) (perim / bl.size());
6191 startPoint = bl[i][bl[i].size()-1];
6192 avgStartDist = perim / npoints;
6193 for (j = 0; j < bl[i].size(); j++)
6194 {
6195 endPoint = bl[i][j];
6196 segment = distance(startPoint.x, startPoint.y,
6197 endPoint.x, endPoint.y);
6198 interpoints = (int)(segment / avgStartDist);
6199 if (interpoints == 0)
6200 interpoints = 1;
6201 dx = (float)(endPoint.x - startPoint.x);
6202 dx = dx / interpoints;
6203 dy = (float)(endPoint.y - startPoint.y);
6204 dy = dy / interpoints;
6205 for (k = 0; k < interpoints; k++)
6206 {
6207 tempPoint.x = startPoint.x + (k * dx);
6208 tempPoint.y = startPoint.y + (k * dy);
6209 tempPoint.mass = POINT_MASS;
6210 tempv.push_back(tempPoint);
6211 }
6212 startPoint = endPoint;
6213 }
6214 tempbl.push_back(tempv);
6215 tempv.clear();
6216 }
6217 bl.clear();
6218 bl = tempbl;
6219 initOlds();
6220 attachScene();
6221 }

6243 std::string getSignature(){
6244 fileText result(";", 80);
6245 result.addLine(toString(seed));
6246 result.addLine(toString(ngroups));
6247 for (UINT i = 0; i < groups.size(); i++){
6248 result.addLine(groups[i]);
6249 }
6250 std::vector<float> origs;
6251 origs.assign((1 << ngroups), 0);
6252 for (UINT j = 0; j < circles.size(); j++){
6253 UINT n = circles[j].n;
6254 origs[n] = circles[j].orig;
6255 }
6256 for (UINT i = 0; i < origs.size(); i++){
6257 result.addLine(toString(origs[i]));
6258 }
6259 return result.getText();

6267 void loadSignature(std::string sig){
6268 sig = exchangeChar(sig, '\n', 0x00);
6269 bl.clear();
6270 circles.clear();
6271 circRadii.clear();
6272 fromSignature = true;
6273 std::vector<std::string> rgroups;
6274 std::vector<std::string> tl;
6275 splitString nums(sig, ';');
6276 std::string nxt;
6277 nxt = purgeLetters(nums.next());
6278 seed = atoi(nxt.c_str());
6279 nxt = purgeLetters(nums.next());
6280 UINT ng = atoi(nxt.c_str());
6281 if (ng > 0){
6282 tl.assign((1 << ng), "");
6283 for (UINT j = 0; j < ng; j++){
6284 nxt = nums.next();
6285 rgroups.push_back(nxt);
6286 //bl.push_back({});
6287 }
6288 if (nums.finished()) setError("Incorrect input at middle");
6289 std::vector<float> tw;
6290 while (!nums.finished()){
6291 nxt = purgeLetters(nums.next());
6292 float n = stof(nxt);
6293 tw.push_back(n);
6294 }
6295 init(rgroups, tw, tl);
6296 }
6297 else{
6298 setError("Incorrect input\n");
6299 return;
6300 }
6301 }

6348 bool setStep(UINT stepNumber = 0){
6349 bool result = true;
6350 if (error){
6351 std::cout << errorMessage << std::endl;
6352 return false;
6353 }
6354 if (stepNumber == attract){
6355 // Start by saving signature
6356 signature = getSignature();
6357 //
6358 refreshScreen.setLimits(1,1);
6359 resetV = false;
6360 setCheckTopol(false);
6361 }
6362 else if (stepNumber == disperse){
6363 setCheckTopol(false);
6364 }
6365 else if (stepNumber == minimizeCompactness){
6366 setFixedCircles(false);
6367 setCheckTopol(true);
6368 resetOptimize();
6369 fixTopology();
6370 oc.maxOutCount = 1 * nregions();
6371 oc.outCount = 0;
6372 oc.optVal = compactness();
6373 optStep.init(oc.optVal);
6374 oc.optVal = outCompactness(&optStep, &borderLine::furthestPoint,
6375 &borderLine::compactness, &borderLine::countCrossings);
6376 }
6377 else if (stepNumber == minimizeCrossings){
6378 resetOptimize();
6379 fixTopology();
6380 oc.maxOutCount = 1 * nregions();
6381 oc.outCount = 0;
6382 oc.optVal = countCrossings();
6383 optStep.init(oc.optVal);
6384 oc.optVal = outCompactness(&optStep, &borderLine::crossestPoint,
6385 &borderLine::countCrossings, &borderLine::compactness);
6386 }
6387 else if (stepNumber == contract){
6388 udt.init(1e-4, 0.01);
6389 resetOptimize();
6390 fixTopology();
6391 setCheckTopol(true);
6392 evaluation.init();
6393 evaluation.setConstants(50, 50);
6394 if (checkTopol() == false){
6395 interpolateToDist(minCircDist());
6396 setPrevState();
6397 setSecureState();
6398 }
6399 else{
6400 listOutsiders();
6401 std::ofstream result;
6402 fileText svgfile = toSVG();
6403 result.open("error.svg");
6404 result.write(svgfile.getText().c_str(), svgfile.getText().size());
6405 result.close();
6406 error = true;
6407 errorMessage = "Could not fix topology at start\n";
6408 }
6409 resetTimer();
6410 attachScene();
6411 scFriction(100);
6412 scD(1e2);
6413 scG(1e-1);
6414 scSpringK(1e4);
6415 scGhostGrav(false);
6416 getBestSoFar();
6417 }
6418 else if (stepNumber == refineCircles){
6419 resetTimer();
6420 resetOptimize();
6421 evaluation.init();
6422 evaluation.setConstants(10, 50);
6423 float d = getEmbellishDist(2);
6424 interpolateToDist(d);
6425 setGravityPartitions();
6426 scSpringK(1e4);
6427 scFriction(1000);
6428 scG(1e-1);
6429 scD(1e2);
6430 scGhostGrav(true);
6431 getBestSoFar();
6432 }
6433 else if (stepNumber == embellishLines){
6434 if (checkTopol() == true){
6435 restorePrevState();
6436 }
6437 resetTimer();
6438 resetOptimize();
6439 evaluation.init();
6440 evaluation.setConstants(10, 0, 1.01, 30);
6441 startRefiningSteps();
6442 resetTimer();
6443 float d = getEmbellishDist(0.4);
6444 interpolateToDist(d);
6445 setGravityPartitions();
6446 this->currentMeasure = &borderLine::getArea;
6447 resetV = true;
6448 scG(2e-1);
6449 scD(50);
6450 scSpringK(5e4);
6451 scFriction(100);
6452 oc.maxOutCount = 70;
6453 oc.outCount = 0;
6454 oc.optVal = 0;
6455 setPrevState();
6456 setSecureState();
6457 }
6458 else{
6459 result = false;
6460 }
6461 return result;
6462 }
6463 bool setCycle(UINT stepNumber = 0){
6464 dataDisplay.clear();
6465 displayUINT("STEP", stepNumber);
6466 if (error){
6467 return false;
6468 }
6469 bool result = true;
6470 if (stepNumber == attract){
6471 setForcesFirstStep();
6472 solve();
6473 }
6474 else if (stepNumber == disperse){
6475 setForcesSecondStep();
6476 setContacts(false, true, 3*maxRad()*AIR);
6477 solve(true);
6478 }
6479 else if (stepNumber == minimizeCompactness){
6480 float thisOut = outCompactness(&optStep, &borderLine::furthestPoint,
6481 &borderLine::compactness, &borderLine::countCrossings);
6482 if (optStep.hasEnded()){
6483 if (thisOut < oc.optVal){
6484 oc.optVal = thisOut;
6485 oc.outCount = 0;
6486 //showCrossings();
6487 }
6488 else{
6489 oc.outCount = oc.outCount + 1;
6490 tolog("Outcount: " + toString(oc.outCount) + "\n");
6491 tolog("Cval: " + toString(oc.optVal) + "\n");
6492 }
6493 //fixTopology();
6494 }
6495 }
6496 else if (stepNumber == minimizeCrossings){
6497 float thisCross = outCompactness(&optStep, &borderLine::crossestPoint,
6498 &borderLine::countCrossings, &borderLine::compactness);
6499 if (optStep.hasEnded()){
6500 if (thisCross < oc.optVal){
6501 oc.optVal = thisCross;
6502 oc.outCount = 0;
6503 // Check for bad topology, restart if necessary
6504 fixTopology();
6505 setCheckTopol(true);
6506 if (checkTopol()){
6507 oc.maxOutCount *= 2;
6508 optStep.init(oc.optVal);
6509 }
6510 //showCrossings();
6511 }
6512 else{
6513 oc.outCount = oc.outCount + 1;
6514 tolog("Outcount: " + toString(oc.outCount) + "\n");
6515 }
6516 //fixTopology();
6517 }
6518 }
6519 else if (stepNumber == contract || stepNumber == refineCircles){
6520 if (checkTopol()){
6521 setError("Bad starting topology");
6522 }
6523 scSolve();
6524 /*if (tosolve.getDebugSignal()){
6525 writeSVG();
6526 exit(0);
6527 }*/
6528 }
6529 else if (stepNumber == embellishLines){
6530 scSolve();
6531 oc.outCount++;
6532 }
6533 else{
6534 result = false;
6535 }
6536 return result;
6537 }
6538 bool isStepFinished(UINT stepNumber = 0){
6539 bool result = false;
6540 if (error == true){
6541 return true;
6542 }
6543 if (stepNumber == attract){
6544 float tc = maxCircleVsq;
6545 if (tc > 0 && tc < 1e-2){
6546 result = true;
6547 }
6548 }
6549 else if (stepNumber == disperse){
6550 if (minCircDist() > (2*maxRad()*AIR)){
6551 result = true;
6552 }
6553 }
6554 else if (stepNumber == minimizeCompactness || stepNumber == minimizeCrossings){
6555 if (oc.outCount > oc.maxOutCount){
6556 result = true;
6557 }
6558 }
6559 else if (stepNumber == contract || stepNumber == refineCircles){
6560 result = isSimulationComplete();
6561 }
6562 else if (stepNumber == embellishLines){
6563 result = isSimulationComplete();
6564 if (result){
6565 blSettings.smoothSVG = true;
6566 currentStep = 1;
6567 }
6568 //if (getMaxVsq() > 1e-7){
6569 // result = false;
6570 //}
6571 }
6572 refreshScreen++;
6573 return result;
6574 }
6575 bool refresh(){
6576 return refreshScreen.isMax();
6577 }

6586 bool simulate(int maxRel = 0){
6587 restart_log();
6588 for (UINT step = currentStep; step < 8; step++){
6589 bool bQuit = false;
6590 std::cout << "Step " << step << std::endl;
6591 bool success = setStep(step);
6592 if (!success) return false;
6593 while (!bQuit){
6594 setCycle(step);
6595 if (err()){
6596 std::cout << errorMessage << std::endl;
6597 bQuit = true;
6598 }
6599 if (refreshScreen.isMax()) writeSVG();
6600 if (isStepFinished(step)){
6601 bQuit = true;
6602 }
6603 }
6604 }
6605 return true;
6606 }
